pillar_reactions.evidence: Understood and welcomed the mobility protocols — 'Okay, that would be great' on the 5-10 minute lymphatic/Qigong-style morning work — but immediately tested it against his existing routine, laying out his Mon/Wed/Fri lifting plus five-a-week sauna and cold plunge and saying 'I would prefer to stay on that. It is working for me. But if it needs to change, I can work with that.' He also probed for travel adaptations: 'I would love to be able to have him throw together body weight exercises, for example, if I'm at an Airbnb.' No pushback on substance, but repeated questions to understand how it would fit.

Pre-aligned and untroubled. He had already described a Paul Saladino-style meat/raw dairy/honey/fruit pattern with an 80-20 allowance, and the rep's 'what you eat, when you eat, how much you eat' framing plus a once-a-week pizza allowance mapped straight onto it. Asked 'any questions on nutrition?' he answered 'Nope.' The only friction he raised was self-reported — difficulty hitting protein because 'I get full pretty quick' — which the rep deferred to Trevor rather than resolving.

Engaged and generally positive — 'I think the social pressure and having somebody right there is going to, it would be very helpful' — but surfaced a genuine reservation about the mechanism: 'I am a very private person, and it's going to be a little weird for me to send videos to somebody. But I'll just have to get over that.' He reasoned himself to the answer ('I can't get feedback without seeing what I'm doing') after the rep pointed out he films in his own home gym.

anchors.raw: I committed to the six months of self-driven exercise with no trainer, nobody, just me and my wife in our gym. And I did that, and I showed up every day, so yeah, I can do this.
anchors.note: A free substitute that demonstrably worked for six months, offered by the prospect as proof of his own reliability rather than as a reason not to buy. It never surfaced as price resistance because no price resistance occurred, but it is the same latent anchor that became a live objection in the Badrane Hriouch call, and the rep did nothing to neutralise it. If this prospect stalls in month two, this is the story he will reach for.

anchors.raw: I've kettlebells, I've got mesas, I've got treadmill, I've got stair climber, I've got all the things.
anchors.note: Owns the entire equipment stack plus sauna and cold plunge, so none of the $6,000 buys him capability he lacks — it buys programming and accountability only. The rep treated this purely as a convenience win ('can I move to in your house?') and never converted it into a value argument for what is actually being paid for.

anchors.raw: My wife might be interested, so I'm going to kind of trial run it, and then she's going to just look at me and be like, holy crap, I don't want to do that. Or she's going to go for it.
anchors.note: Household is treating this as a trial run with a second purchase behind it, which supports rather than resists the price. Corroborated downstream: a Robyn Stillwater closed with the same rep on 2026-07-23 through an existing-client partner.

unmet_demand.want: Programming that is coordinated with, or at least cleared by, the physiotherapist actively treating his shoulder and knee, given hypermobility and three replaced cervical discs — he flagged the constraint himself with 'I will need to start probably a bit lighter on anything that touches my shoulders.'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep answered the medical disclosure with his own recovery anecdote and a general promise to 'address these injuries', but never established whether the programme accommodates a connective-tissue disorder, never asked what the physio permits, and offered no clinician-coordination step. Whether Trevor can or does work with a treating clinician was left entirely unanswered.

unmet_demand.want: A separate account and direct coaching for his wife so she gets her own form feedback rather than being taught by him
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep confirmed Trevor works with women and that every programme is individual, which implies a second full-price purchase, but never priced it, never explored it and never followed up on it as an opportunity.
